During the post-colonial period of 1976, he advised Carter on foreign policy, after which he served as national security advisor (NSA) from 1977 to 1981, the man who replaced Henry Kissinger.
Ní ọdún 1976, ó fún Carter ní ìmọ̀ràn lórí ìlànà ìjọba, lẹ́yìn náà, ó jẹ́ Olùdarí Ààbò Orílẹ̀-èdè (NSA) láti ọdún 1977 sí 1981, tí ó rọ́pò Henry Kissinger.
A lokacin zabar 1976, ya ba da shawarar Carter kan harkokin waje, daga baya ya yi aiki a matsayin mai ba da shawara kan tsaro na kasa (NSA) daga 1977 zuwa 1981, inda ya gaji Henry Kissinger.
N'oge nhọpụta nke 1976, o nyere Carter ndụmọdụ n'ihe gbasara ihe gbasara mba ofesi, mgbe ahụ ọ rụrụ ọrụ dị ka onye ndụmọdụ nchekwa obodo (NSA) site na 1977 ruo 1981, na-anọchi anya Henry Kissinger.

As the NSA, he assisted Carter in resolving the Global Economic Crisis, such as the Camp David Accords of 1978; mediating a change in the US-China relationship at the end of the 1970s; confronting the Iranian Revolution that led to the hostage crisis in 1979; and removing the Soviets from Afghanistan in 1979.

Gẹ́gẹ́ bí Olùdarí NSA, ó ràn Carter lọ́wọ́ ní ìmúrasílẹ̀ àwọn ọ̀rọ̀ àgbáyé, bíi Àdéhùn Ìparapọ̀ Camp David, 1978; ìmúrasílẹ̀ ìbásepọ̀ US–China nípasẹ̀ àwọn ọdún 1970; ìyípadà ìjọba ní Iran, èyí tó yọrí sí ìdìbò ìdìbò, 1979; àti ìkọlu Soviet ní Afghanistan, 1979.

A matsayin NSA, ya taimaka wa Carter wajen kula da harkokin duniya ta hanyar diflomasiya, kamar yarjejeniyar Camp David, 1978; daidaitar dangantakar Amurka da Sin ta hanyar shekaru 1970; juyin juya halin Iran, wanda ya haifar da rikicinama da Iran, 1979; da kuma mamayar Soviet a Afghanistan, 1979.

N'oge ọrụ ya dị ka onye isi ọrụ nke National Security Agency (NSA), ọ nyere Carter aka n'ịchịkwa ihe gbasara ihe gbasara mba ụwa, dịka nkwekọrita Camp David, 1978; ime ka mmekọrịta US na China dị mma n'oge 1970s; mgbanwe na Iran, nke mere ka ọ bụrụ nsogbu ndị agha Iran, 1979; na mbuso agha Soviet na Afghanistan, 1979.
